close_decision: Q1.1 Performance Authority is closed. No unresolved critical physical or controlled-environment performance/correctness issue remains.

closeout_commit.subject: Close Q1.1 performance authority
closeout_commit.note: SELF denotes the commit that first contains this manifest; its exact hash is reported after commit because a Git commit cannot contain its own hash.

authority_distinction.controlled_emulator: The canonical regression authorities use fixed deterministic fixtures and controlled emulator configurations described by each curated record.
authority_distinction.physical: PHYSICAL DEVICE REFERENCE — NOT A UNIVERSAL ANDROID PERFORMANCE REQUIREMENT
authority_distinction.physical_role: One non-destructive ARM64 same-device/model reference and broad directional sanity channel; it does not replace canonical MEDIUM or universalize device timings.

Q1.1a.name: Benchmark Foundation
Q1.1a.principal_result: Established the AndroidX Macrobenchmark module, release-like benchmark target, smoke benchmark, and dependency/toolchain foundation used by later Q1.1 phases.
Q1.1a.principal_limitations: Infrastructure validation alone creates no numeric performance baseline.
Q1.1a.future_use: Maintain as shared infrastructure; invoke the relevant later authority instead of treating Q1.1a smoke output as performance evidence.

Q1.1b.name: Fixture & Reference Authority
Q1.1b.principal_result: Established deterministic EMPTY through STRESS profiles, byte-level fixture fingerprints, guarded emulator-only provisioning, and the immutable v1.0.4 comparison worktree.
Q1.1b.principal_limitations: Fixture generation/provisioning time is not app performance; public-media cleanup is emulator-only and path constrained.
Q1.1b.future_use: Use as the input/reference layer whenever a later controlled authority requires canonical fixtures or v1.0.4 comparison.

Q1.1c.name: Startup Authority
Q1.1c.principal_result: Established cached MEDIUM cold-start reference distributions and fully-drawn semantics on the controlled API 28 emulator; curated reference medians are 1086.807 ms TTID and 1256.936 ms TTFD.
Q1.1c.principal_limitations: API 28 x86_64 emulator timing is controlled regression evidence, not universal device performance.
Q1.1c.future_use: Invoke for startup, initial navigation, cached-library usability, and fully-drawn changes.

Q1.1d.name: Library UI Authority
Q1.1d.classification: SONGS/ALBUMS NUMERIC; SEARCH CORRECTNESS + TRACE; HOT RETURN LIMITED NUMERIC AUTHORITY
Q1.1d.principal_result: Established controlled MEDIUM Songs and Albums frame distributions, 450/450 Search query-state validations, and 120/120 hot-return cached-content validations across the balanced reference/development matrix.
Q1.1d.principal_limitations: Search frame samples are too sparse/noisy for numeric authority; hot-return frame timing is diagnostic and only TTID has limited numeric authority.
Q1.1d.future_use: Invoke the affected Songs, Albums, Search, or hot-return journey for Compose/library UI changes.

Q1.1e.name: Synchronization Authority
Q1.1e.classification: EXACT SYNCHRONIZATION CORRECTNESS; REBUILD NUMERIC; OTHER MUTATIONS LIMITED NUMERIC AUTHORITY
Q1.1e.principal_result: Established exact unchanged/add/delete/modify/rebuild catalog behavior and bounded MediaStore-to-Room timing with isolated deterministic mutations.
Q1.1e.principal_limitations: Host/emulator noise limits unchanged and mutation timing precision; SAF breadth and LARGE synchronization remain outside the accepted primary matrix.
Q1.1e.future_use: Invoke for scanner, MediaStore, metadata refresh, rebuild, deletion, modification, and SAF synchronization changes.

Q1.1f.name: Playback-Under-Load Authority
Q1.1f.classification: PLAYBACK CONTINUITY AUTHORITY + LIMITED NUMERIC LOAD AUTHORITY
Q1.1f.principal_result: All 120 primary refresh/add/rebuild-under-playback operations preserved Media3 session identity, position progress, connection, and catalog correctness with zero player errors or discontinuities.
Q1.1f.principal_limitations: Emulator-observable session continuity is not acoustic dropout, DAC, Bluetooth, or physical AudioTrack authority; timing spread limits numeric precision.
Q1.1f.future_use: Invoke for PlaybackService, Media3/session, queue, background playback, scanner-under-playback, and audio lifecycle changes.

Q1.1g.name: Memory / Resource Authority
Q1.1g.classification: RETAINED-MEMORY NUMERIC; LIMITED SONGS/ALBUMS; RESOURCE CORRECTNESS + TRACE AUTHORITY
Q1.1g.principal_result: Thirty journeys, 264 settled checkpoints, and 30 traces showed warm/plateau rather than ratchet behavior; playback resources were correct at every active and post-stop checkpoint.
Q1.1g.principal_limitations: Shell could not count FDs on API 36; no heap ownership/leak causation or universal physical memory claim is established.
Q1.1g.future_use: Invoke the bounded affected channel for allocation-sensitive Search, Songs, Albums/artwork, playback, lifecycle, or cache changes.

Q1.1h.name: Baseline Profile Authority
Q1.1h.principal_result: ACCEPT AND SHIP PROFILE: packaged ART delivery and speed-profile application passed; controlled A/B showed credible TTFD and broad Songs/Albums frame improvement with real playback correctness.
Q1.1h.principal_limitations: Strict generation reproducibility is not established, TTID benefit is not credible, and the emulator result is not universal Android performance.
Q1.1h.future_use: Reassess/regenerate only when startup/navigation, Songs/Albums rendering, playback/Now Playing entry, hot-path architecture, or the profile toolchain materially changes.

Q1.1i.name: Physical Reference & Q1.1 Close
Q1.1i.principal_result: A side-by-side isolated build ran on ARM64 Samsung hardware: five profiled cold starts, three Songs and Albums journeys, continuous two-minute background playback, three unchanged refreshes, one isolated rebuild, five resource checkpoints, and a tiny 20-start profile A/B completed without a critical app failure. ART reached speed-profile.
Q1.1i.principal_limitations: One device and a private real-world 940-track library do not establish universal or canonical MEDIUM authority. TTID reversed in the tiny A/B while TTFD retained the accepted direction.
Q1.1i.future_use: Invoke as a bounded non-destructive physical sanity/reference pass for broad release candidates, not for every commit.
